chapters.title: وا حر قلباه ممن قلبه شبم

blocks.text:
وَا حَـرَّ قَلبـاهُ مِمَّـن قـَلْـبُهُ شَبـِمُ
ومَـن بِجـِسمـي وَحـالي عِنْـدَهُ سَقَـمُ

ما لي أُكَتِّـمُ حُبّـاً قد بَـرَى جَسَـدي
وتَدَّعِـي حُـبَّ سَيـفِ الدَولـةِ الأُمَـمُ

إِنْ كـانَ يَـجمَـعـُنـا حُبٌّ لِغُـرَّتـِهِ
فَلَـيتَ أَنَّـا بِقَـدْرِ الحُـبِّ نَقـتَسِـمُ

قـد زُرتُـه وسُيـُوفُ الهـِنـدِ مُغمَدةٌ
وقـد نَظَـرتُ إليـهِ والسُـيُـوفُ دَمُ

وَ كـانَ أَحـسَـنَ خـَلـقِ الله كُلِّهـِـمِ
وكانَ أَحْسَنَ مـا في الأَحسَـنِ الشِيَـمُ

فـَوتُ العَـدُوِّ الِّـذي يَمَّمْتـَهُ ظَفَـرٌ
في طَـيِّـهِ أَسَــفٌ في طَـيِّــهِ نِـعَــمُ

قد نابَ عنكَ شَدِيدُ الخَوفِ واصطَنَعـَتْ
لَكَ المَهابةُ مـا لا تَصْنـعُ البُـهَـمُ

أَلزَمْتَ نَفْسَكَ شَيْئاً لَيـسَ يَلْزَمـُهـا
أَنْ لا يُـوارِيَـهُـم أرضٌ ولا عَـلَــمُ

أَكـلما رُمتَ جَيشاً فانثَنـَى هَرَبـاً
تَـصَـرَّفَـتْ بِـكَ في آثـارِهِ الـهِمَـمُ

عـلَـيـكَ هَـزمـُهـُمُ في كُـلِّ مُعْتَـرَكٍ
وما عَلَيكَ بِهِمْ عـارٌ إِذا انهَزَمـوا

أَمـا تَرَى ظَفـَراً حُلواً سـِوَى ظَفـَرٍ
تَصافَحَتْفيهِ بيـضُ الهِـنْدِ والِلمَـمُ

يـا أَعـدَلَ النـاسِ إِلاَّ في مُعامَلَـتي
فيكَ الخِصـامُ وأَنـتَ الخَصْـمُ والحَكَـمُ

أُعِيـذُهـا نَظَــراتٍ مِنْـكَ صادِقـَـةً
أَنْ تَحْسَبَ الشَحمَ فيمَـن شَحْمُـهُ وَرَمُ

وما انتِفاعُ أَخي الدُنيا بِناظـرِهِ
إِذا استَوَتْ عِنـدَهُ الأَنوارُ والظُلَمُ

سَيَعْلَـمُ الجَمْـعُ مِمَّـن ضَـمَّ مَجْلِسُنـا
بِأنَّني خَيْرُ مَـن تَسْـعَـى بـِـهِ قـدَمُ

أَنـا الَّذي نَظَرَ الأَعمَـى إلى أَدَبـي
وأَسمَـعَـتْ كَلِماتـي مَـن بـِـهِ صَمَـمُ

أَنـامُ مِـلءَ جُفُـوفي عـن شَوارِدِهـا
ويَسْـهَـرُ الخَلْـقُ جَرَّاهـا ويَختَـصِـمُ

وَجَـاهِـلٍ مَــدَّهُ في جَهـلِـهِ ضـَحِكـِي
حَـتَّـى أَتَـتْـهُ يَـدٌ فَـرَّاسـةٌ وفَـمُ

إِذا رَأيـتَ نُيُـوبَ اللّيـثِ بـارِزَةً
فَـلا تَظُـنَّـنَ أَنَّ اللَيـثَ يَبْـتَـسِـمُ

ومُهجةٍ مُهجتـي مِن هَــمِّ صـاحِبِهـا
أَدرَكْـتُهـا بـِجَـوادٍ ظَـهْـرُهُ حَـرَمُ

رِجلاهُ في الـرَكضِ رِجْلٌ واليَـدانِ يَدٌ
وفِعْلُهُ مـا تُريـدُ الكَـفُّ والقَـدَمُ

ومُرهَفٍ سِـرتُ بَينَ الجَـحْـفَـلَيـنِ بـِهِ
حتَّى ضَرَبْتُ ومَـوجُ المَـوتِ يَلْـتَـطِـمُ

الخَيْلُ واللّيلُ والبَيداءُ تَعرِفُـنـي
والسَيفُ والرُمْحُ والقِرطاسُ والقَلَمُ

صَحِبتُ في الفَلَواتِ الوَحشَ مُـنْفـَرِداً
حتَّـى تَعَـجَّـبَ منَّي القُـورُ والأَكَـمُ

يـا مَن يَعِزُّ عَلَينـا أن نُفارِقَهـم
وَجداننـا كُـلَّ شَيءٍ بَعـدَكـُمْ عَـدَمُ

مـا كانَ أَخلَقَنـا مِنكُم بِتَكـرِمـة
لَـو أَن أَمرَكـُمُ مـِن أَمـرِنا أَمـَمُ

إِن كـانَ سَرَّكـُـمُ ما قـالَ حاسِدُنا
فَـمـا لِجُـرْحٍ إِذا أَرضـاكُـمُ أَلـَمُ

وبَينَنـا لَو رَعَيْتُـمْ ذاكَ مَعـرِفـةٌ
إِنَّ المَعـارِفَ في أَهلِ النُهـَى ذِمـَـمُ

كَم تَطلُبُـونَ لَنـا عَيبـاً فيُعجِزُكم
ويَكـرَهُ الله مـا تـأْتُـونَ والكَـرَمُ

ما أَبعَدَ العَيْبَ والنُقصانَ من شَرَفي
أَنا الثُرَيَّا وَذانِ الشَيبُ والـهَرَمُ

لَيتَ الغَمـامَ الذي عِندِي صَواعِقُـهُ
يُـزِيلُـهُـنَّ إلى مَـن عِنـدَه الدِيـَمُ

أَرَى النَـوَى يَقْتَضِيني كُــلَّ مَرْحَلـةٍ
لا تَستَقِلُّ بـِها الوَخَـّادةُ الرُسـُـمُ

لَئِـن تَرَكْـنَ ضُمَيـراً عن مَيامِنِنـا
لَيـَحْـدُثَـنَّ لِمـَنْ ودَّعْتـُهُـمْ نَــدَمُ

إذا تَرَحَّلْتَ عن قَـومٍ وقد قَــدَروا
أَن لا تُفـارِقَهم فالـراحِـلُونَ هُـمُ

شَـرُّ البـِلادِ مَكـانٌ لا صـَديـقَ بـهِ
وشَرُّ ما يَكْسِـبُ الإِنسـانُ مـا يَصِـمُ

وشَــرُّ ما قَنَصَتْــهُ راحَـتـي قَنـَصٌ
شُهْبُ البُـزاةِ سَواءٌ فيـهِ والرَخَـمُ

بأَيَّ لَفْـظٍ تَقُـولُ الشِعْـرَ زِعْنِـفـةٌ
تـجـُوزْ عِنـدَكَ لا عـُرْبٌ وِلا عـَجـَـمُ

هـذا عِـتابــكَ إِلاَّ أَنـَّـهُ مـِقـَـةٌ
قـد ضُمـِّـنَ الـدُرَّ إِلاَّ أَنَّـهُ كَـلِـمُ

english.text:
Ah, my heart burns for one whose heart is cold,
in whose regard my body and fortunes are ailing.

Why should I hide a love that has worn my body away,
while whole nations claim to love Sayf al-Dawla?

If love for his radiant face unites us,
would that our shares of his favor matched our love.

I have visited him when Indian swords were sheathed,
and looked upon him when those swords were bloodied.

He was the finest of all God's creatures,
and the finest thing in that finest man was his character.

The escape of the enemy you pursued is a victory
that contains regret, yet within that regret are blessings.

Great terror has acted in your place;
your awe has accomplished what fearless warriors could not.

You have imposed on yourself a duty that is not yours:
that neither land nor mountain should shelter them.

Must your ambition send you following their tracks
every time you seek an army and it turns in flight?

Your task is to defeat them on every battlefield;
there is no disgrace to you when they flee.

Do you see no sweet victory except one
in which bright Indian blades meet the hair upon their heads?

Most just of men, except in your treatment of me!
The quarrel concerns you, and you are both opponent and judge.

I would protect your discerning gaze
from mistaking a man's swelling for healthy flesh.

What use are a man's eyes in this world
if light and darkness are alike to him?

Everyone gathered in our assembly will learn
that I am the best of those whom feet carry.

I am the one whose verse the blind have seen,
whose words have reached even the deaf.

I sleep with eyelids full, untroubled by my roaming verses,
while others stay awake over them and dispute.

Many a fool my laughter encouraged in his folly,
until a rending hand and mouth came upon him.

When you see the lion's fangs exposed,
do not suppose the lion is smiling.

Many a life whose owner sought my own
I overtook on a noble horse whose back was a sanctuary.

In running, his two hind legs are one, his forelegs one;
he does whatever hand and foot command.

With many a keen-edged sword I went between two armies
and struck while the waves of death crashed together.

Horses, night, and the wilderness know me,
and sword, spear, paper, and pen.

Alone I kept company with wild beasts in empty lands,
until the hills and heights marveled at me.

You whose parting is so painful to us,
finding everything after you is finding nothing.

How worthy we were of honor from you,
if your disposition toward us had resembled ours toward you.

If what our envier said has pleased you,
then a wound that satisfies you gives us no pain.

Between us is an acquaintance, if you would honor it;
among people of understanding, such ties are obligations.

How often you seek a fault in us and fail!
God and generosity alike reject what you do.

How far are fault and deficiency from my honor!
I am the Pleiades; those two are gray hair and old age.

Would that the cloud whose thunderbolts strike me
would carry them to those who receive its gentle rains.

I see separation demanding journey after journey of me,
such as swift, long-striding she-camels cannot undertake.

If they leave Dumayr on our right,
those I have said farewell to will surely come to regret it.

When you depart from people who had the power
to keep you with them, it is they who have departed.

The worst of lands is a place without a friend;
the worst thing a person gains is what brings disgrace.

The worst quarry my hand has ever caught
is prey in which gray falcons and vultures have equal shares.

With what language does that rabble compose poetry
that passes with you, though they are neither Arabs nor non-Arabs?

This is my reproach to you, yet it is affection;
it contains pearls, though it is made of words.
